headline: Dove za svaki dan. Uvijek pri ruci.
subtitle: Čitajte dove uz transkripciju i prijevod.
prompt:
Use case: compositing / ads-marketing.
Create ONE portrait Google Play listing concept for the Vaktija app's DOVE feature, matching the approved ivory timetable poster exactly as a coherent next image in the same series.
Input image 1: the approved ivory timetable poster. This is the EDIT TARGET and exact design template. Preserve its warm ivory paper background, thin sage geometric border and corner details, original dome-and-crescent logo, VAKTIJA wordmark, deep emerald elegant serif typography, gold accent line, soft diffuse lighting, large centered upright champagne Android phone, realistic bezel and shadow.
Input image 2: the user's actual light-theme DOVE screen. This is the screen insert. Replace ONLY the phone's timetable display with this exact supplied dove screenshot. Composite the screenshot faithfully, removing only Android status notifications and bottom gesture bar. Keep the original screenshot proportions inside the same phone display. Its first card is "Dova potrebe", then "Dova za znanje". Preserve Arabic text including every diacritic, transliteration, Bosnian translation, source citations, crescent badges, bookmark icons, card borders, mosque and lake artwork exactly as in the supplied screenshot. Treat the screenshot as a flattened photograph to insert, not UI to redraw. No invented UI, changed Arabic letters, translated text, modified source references, or new controls.
Replace ONLY the poster marketing headline above the phone with these exact words, set in two lines:
"Dove za svaki dan.
Uvijek pri ruci."
Preserve the premium left-aligned emerald serif style. Size the type to fit safely within the existing header width, using a modest reduction if needed. All words and punctuation must be exact.
Replace the small poster subtitle with EXACTLY:
"Čitajte dove uz transkripciju i prijevod."
Set in the template's emerald sans-serif, wrapped into two balanced lines: "Čitajte dove uz" / "transkripciju i prijevod."
Keep the device the same large size and position, with the same margins and hierarchy as the template. No extra decoration, props, people, hands, badges, floating panels, buttons or watermarks.
Output one portrait image, intended 9:16. Do not produce a comparison or contact sheet. This is the second listing image in an approved series, not a new design direction.
